mapper.insert: insert into ym_scan_logs (verification_id, code, scan_ip, user_agent, scanned_at) values (#{verificationId}, #{code}, #{scanIp}, #{userAgent}, #{scannedAt})
mapper.select: select count(1) from ym_scan_logs where verification_id = #{verificationId}
select scanned_at from ym_scan_logs where verification_id = #{verificationId} order by scanned_at asc, id asc limit 1
